title: The Collapse Of A Billionaire Tech Cult
content:
Some of Silicon Valley’s wealthiest tech elites have a radical new dream to abandon modern democracy completely and build their own sovereign nation. A millionaire VC named Balaji Srinivasan is the leader of this new movement and he calls it the "Network State".

In this episode of my podcast, I speak with freelance journalist Sam Venis about his firsthand reporting at Balaji's Network School. We discuss what really went down at Balaji’s experimental new government pop up set up inside Forest City, a massive, abandoned ghost city in Malaysia. From aggressive NDAs and toxic black mold to clashes with local governments and authoritarian power trips, Sam breaks down his firsthand investigation into tech’s most bizarre and dangerous exit strategy.
